title: Inside The First Home Wi‑Fi

scenes.text: Which café hosted the world’s first public Wi‑Fi hotspot?
scenes.query: first public Wi‑Fi hotspot coffee shop 1991

scenes.text: A 1991 laptop equipped with a 802.11 prototype connected to a router placed under the counter.
scenes.label: 802.11 PROTOTYPE LAPTOP

scenes.text: The router broadcast on 2.4 GHz, offering about 100 kbps to patrons—a speed unimaginable today.
scenes.label: 100KBPS 2.4GHZ SIGNAL

scenes.text: The experiment proved wireless internet could work in public spaces, sparking the modern hotspot era.
scenes.label: SPARKED HOTSPOT ERA
